kicker: THE NEW TRAP FOR YOUNG MEN
title: Sports betting is *porn 2.0*

items.head: The house always wins
items.sub: The apps are built so the average bettor loses.

items.head: Every game becomes a bill
items.sub: You stop watching the game. You watch your balance.

label: THE DRILL
head: Stare at a wall for 15 minutes
sub: No phone, no music. It rebuilds the boredom tolerance betting killed.

label: TONIGHT
head: Delete the app
sub: Not "bet less". Delete it and block the site.

text: The thrill is the product. *You* are the one paying for it.
